 Judgment
IA No.64866/2024-EXEMPTION FROM FILING O.T. IA No.64857/2024-EXEMPTION FROM SURRENDERING WITHIN TIME ) Date : 18-03-2024
This petition was called on for hearing today.

CORAM :
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE UJJAL BHUYAN [IN CHAMBER] For Petitioner(s) Mr.
Abjit Kumar Chattopadhyay, Adv.
Ms. Swati, Adv.
Mr. Sagar Roy, Adv.
Mr. Sandeep Lamba, Adv.
Ms. Jyoti, Adv.
Ms. Khushboo Tomar, Adv.
Mr. Indresh Chandra Sonkar, Adv.
Mr. Goverdhan Pd. Tiwari, Adv.
Mr. Dhiraj Kumar Sammi, AOR For Respondent(s) UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following O R D E R IA No.64857/2024-EXEMPTION FROM SURRENDERING WITHIN TIME Heard learned counsel for the petitioner(s).
This interlocutory application has been filed seeking exemption from surrendering.

Petitioners were convicted by the Municipal Magistrate, 3rd Court, Calcutta in Case No.14D/2009 for the offence under Section 16(1)(a)(i) of the Prevention of Food Jhuma Ghosh vs The State Of West Bengal on 18 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109634071/
1 Adulteration Act, 1954 (the Act, hereinafter) vide the judgment and order dated 31.07.2013. By the aforesaid judgment, petitioners were sentenced to suffer simple imprisonment for six months and also to pay a fine of Rs.1,000/- with a default stipulation.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Appeal filed by the petitioners being Crl. A. No.88/2013 was dismissed by the Additional District & Sessions Judge, Bench II, City Sessions Court, Bichar Bhawan, Calcutta vide the judgment and order dated 19.09.2014.

entities.text: Additional District & Sessions Judge, Bench II, City Sessions Court, Bichar Bhawan, Calcutta
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Revision filed by the petitioners before the High Court of Calcutta being C.R.R.
No.15/2015 was dismissed vide the judgment and order dated 19.01.2024.
Learned counsel for the petitioner(s) submits that the petitioners have no antecedents and were on bail all throughout.
Having regard to the above and considering the duration of the sentence, the petitioners are granted exemption from surrendering.
Application seeking exemption from surrendering is accordingly allowed.

(RASHMI DHYANI PANT) (RAM SUBHAG SINGH) COURT MASTER (SH) COURT MASTER (NSH)
